notes: Reached by plain direct HTTP fetch (no proxy needed). Counts come from the rendered listing header 'Search within N results' and were cross-checked on every page against the embedded JSON "totalResults" and the page title '<Category> - N For Sale at 1stDibs' - all three agree on all 49 leaf nodes. Exactness proven by exhaustion on three nodes: Girandoles 60+19=79, Tureens 8x60+29=509, Shadow Boxes 2x60+27=147, each matching the reported total exactly, so 1stDibs' structured total is NOT inflated. Taxonomy taken at the site's stable L3 category level under Furniture > Lighting / Mirrors / Wall Decorations / Decorative Objects / Dining & Entertaining; period, style, origin, material, creator and price facet paths were ignored per instruction. Dropped as pure re-cuts (verified by checking the canonical category in each tile's own product URL): 'Decorative Lighting & Lamps' (17,324 - only 1.7% of its items are canonically its own; the rest belong to Chandeliers/Sconces/Table Lamps) and 'More Mirrors' (2,786 - 83% are canonically Wall Mirrors). Dropped as mixed roll-ups after reading real product titles: Barware (7,105 - half bottle openers, corkscrews, nutcrackers, cocktail picks), Tableware (8,506 - dominated by flatware and cutlery services), Sterling Silver (8,494 - jewelry, card cases, walking sticks, cutlery canteens), Sheffield Silverplate (1,773 - cutlery-heavy), More Dining & Entertaining (2,155 - espresso makers, cutting boards, bread slicers), Boxes roll-up and Bowls & Baskets roll-up (took their in-scope children instead). Also excluded per scope: Desk Accessories, Ashtrays, Butcher Blocks, Knife Boxes, Shelves & Wall Cabinets (storage furniture), Wallpaper, and everything under Furniture, Rugs & Carpets, Storage & Case Pieces, Building & Garden. Caveat: 1stDibs is a marketplace where a listing can carry more than one category tag, so sibling nodes overlap by roughly 15% (e.g. mirror children sum to 33,634 against a 28,657 parent). Each qty is nonetheless the exact number the site itself reports for that URL.
